name: Conversion Library
description: Proven conversion patterns for acquisition and revenue. Every landing page and purchase flow is measured against these.

items.title: CTA placement rules
items.summary: Primary CTA above the fold, repeated at scroll end and mid-page, sticky on long pages, and visible without scrolling on mobile.
items.content: The primary CTA appears above the fold, and is repeated after key persuasion blocks (social proof, benefits, testimonials) and at the end. On long sales pages use a sticky CTA bar. Mobile CTAs sit in the thumb zone (bottom).
rules: Repeat after each proof block + end

items.title: Sticky CTA
items.summary: Persistent CTA bar that remains visible while scrolling; appears after the hero scrolls away.
items.content: Sticky CTAs catch the buyer who is about to bounce. Trigger after the visitor scrolls past the hero. Keep it minimal (price + button). Hide when the footer's final CTA is in view.

items.title: Buy Now button placement
items.summary: On product pages the Buy Now button sits above the fold, to the right of the product image, under the price, repeated below the fold and in a sticky mobile bar.
items.content: Buy Now must be visible without scrolling on the product page - right of the main image, below the price. Repeat near the bottom after the description/specs. On mobile, a fixed bottom bar with the price and Buy Now converts best. The Buy Now button uses a shopping-bag icon + explicit label and the strongest visual contrast on the page.
rules: Buy Now above the fold next to image
Repeat below fold + mobile sticky bar

items.title: Free trial best practices
items.summary: Time-limited trials (7-14 days) with no credit card outperform unlimited free tiers for conversion to paid when the product shows value fast.
items.content: Use trials when value is visible within days. Requiring a card at trial start increases commitment but lowers trial starts - test. Send trial-lifecycle emails (day 1 activation, day 3 tips, day 7 value recap, day 13 upgrade). Auto-downgrade at end.

items.title: Pricing display
items.summary: Show monthly price, annual savings toggle, per-seat clarity, and a highlighted popular tier.
items.content: Price is visible and unambiguous. Annual toggle pre-selected to annual when it's the better deal for the company. 'Most popular' badge on the middle tier. Never show confusing math - one clear price.

items.title: Guarantee strategies
items.summary: A strong guarantee ('30-day money back') lifts conversion more than it costs; put it next to the CTA.
items.content: Guarantees reduce perceived risk, the #1 purchase barrier. Make them specific and unconditional. Money-back guarantees lift conversion measurably and redemption rates are low. Place the guarantee beside the CTA and at checkout.

items.title: Lead magnets & gated assets
items.summary: Gate high-value content (templates, benchmarks, calculators) behind a 2-3 field form for B2B email capture.
items.content: Lead magnets convert cold traffic into contacts. Best formats: templates, ROI calculators, benchmark reports, checklists. Form is 2-3 fields. Deliver instantly via email + redirect. Nurture with a short automated sequence.

items.title: Upsell & cross-sell
items.summary: Offer the next tier or related product after the main purchase decision, not before.
items.content: Post-purchase upsells and cross-sells convert because the decision barrier is already crossed. Show upgrades on the confirmation page and in-app. Never upsell before checkout - it distracts from the primary decision.

categories.name: Forms & Checkout
categories.description: Removing friction at the moment of truth.

items.title: Checkout friction reduction
items.summary: Guest checkout first, auto-fill, no account requirement, express payment, and a progress bar for multi-page checkouts.
items.content: Every field costs money. Use guest checkout by default, save shipping/billing info, support express wallets, and show order summary throughout. Offer email-only account creation after purchase, not before.

items.title: Form conversion rules
items.summary: Minimize fields, label above field, inline validation, and a strong submit button with a benefit label.
items.content: Every extra field drops completion ~5-15%. Ask only what you need now. Validate inline. The submit button states the benefit ('Get my free report'). Place the button where visible without scrolling.

items.title: Booking / contact pages
items.summary: Show availability, time estimates, and next steps. Offer scheduling links over back-and-forth emails.
items.content: For services, a booking link (show real availability, auto-confirm, reminders) beats email back-and-forth. Contact forms state response time. Both work best with a specific offer and urgency ('Limited slots this month').

categories.name: Conversion Analytics
categories.description: How to measure and find leaks.

items.title: Funnel metrics to track
items.summary: Traffic -> signup -> activation -> paid -> retained. Track each conversion rate; fix the biggest drop-off first.
items.content: Map the full funnel and measure each step: visit-to-signup, signup-to-activated, activated-to-paid, and 30/90-day retention. The biggest drop-off is your priority. Compare rates across channels to find the best acquisition source.

items.title: A/B testing
items.summary: Test one variable at a time (headline, CTA, price framing, section order) with sufficient sample before concluding.
items.content: Isolate one variable per test. Reach statistical significance before shipping. Document every test and its result - the learning is the asset. Prioritize tests on the pages with the most traffic and revenue impact.
